title: Java
blurb: Java from the first `javac` to code a senior reviewer would approve: objects, the stack and the heap, inheritance, exceptions, collections, generics, streams, threads and build tools, then the craft of writing good Java (factories, equals and hashCode, immutability, PECS, enums, concurrency) and the interview questions that come up again and again. Written for complete beginners, with runnable models.
sources: Kathy Sierra, Bert Bates & Trisha Gee, Head First Java (O'Reilly), all chapters and appendices (topic coverage and fact-checking only; all wording, programs and analogies are original)
Joshua Bloch, Effective Java, 3rd ed. (Addison-Wesley), items 1-90 (topic coverage and fact-checking only; all wording and examples are original)
Oracle Java SE documentation and the Java Language Specification, docs.oracle.com/en/java/
